items.name: Junior Full Stack Developer
items.description: - Maintenance across +170 international units I work as a Full Stack Developer on several projects in constant evolution, contributing to practically every area of the system. - Creation of **new API routes** and **new pages**, such as scheduling, workouts, fitness assessments, and plans/subscriptions, among several others. - **Refactoring** and **general maintenance** of legacy code, improving quality, performance, and maintainability. - Development and maintenance of complex Full Stack projects in TypeScript, from database and APIs to modern, responsive interfaces. - Building **robust APIs** in JavaScript and PHP, integrated with MySQL, SQL, Supabase, and Prisma ORM. - Process automation and tool integration with n8n and Unichat, optimizing internal workflows. - Creating advanced analytical dashboards and reports using BigQuery data to support strategic decisions. - Version control and collaboration using Git, implementing **branching, merges, and efficient workflows**. - Multidisciplinary teamwork, ensuring **high quality and performance** across all deliveries, plus several other contributions as the project requires. - **Building AI-powered automated customer service via WhatsApp using n8n**, improving communication and client support.

items.name: Personal Full Stack Projects (private, public / Freelance)
items.description: Development of over 20 projects applying best practices and professional solutions. - Projects cover **front-end and back-end**, API integration, databases, and production deployment. - Application of **best practices in architecture, performance, and scalability** to deliver high-quality solutions. - Constant exploration of new approaches, ensuring **innovation and continuous learning**.
